blocks.text: WASHINGTON — A forty-year-old woman in the US state of Pennsylvania has died of measles, authorities said Sunday, bringing this year’s death toll from the highly contagious, preventable disease to three, amid declining vaccination rates. The resident of Jefferson County died Saturday from complications associated with measles, the county’s coroner’s office said in a statement
